description.en: Generates / updates README.md and CHANGELOG.md after feature changes. Requires a SaaS factory in the project (directory saas-factory/ or FACTORY_ROOT with the CLI tools/factory); it is not part of this repository.
description.de: Generiert / aktualisiert README.md und CHANGELOG.md nach Feature-Änderungen. Voraussetzung: eine SaaS-Factory im Projekt (Verzeichnis saas-factory/ oder FACTORY_ROOT mit der CLI tools/factory); sie gehört nicht zu diesem Repository.

author: MySuricates
instructions: Documentation update for a generated app. Keep it brief — no bullet lists of AI filler phrases. The README describes setup, running and architecture. The CHANGELOG has the date + a list of the features in this run.

config.success_criteria: README.md and CHANGELOG.md exist in the project and are up to date.
config.goal:
Update the documentation in project {{ slug }} (path: ${FACTORY_ROOT:-./saas-factory}/{{ slug }}).

Read first:
- spec.md (if present, one level up: ../{{ slug }}.spec.md or in the parent project)
- src/app/page.tsx and, if present, src/app/(marketing)/page.tsx
- prisma/schema.prisma
- package.json (for stack + scripts)

Then:
1. Overwrite README.md with:
   - a one-sentence description (from the spec, not invented)
   - Quick start: docker compose up -d, port from .factory-port
   - Stack list (one line)
   - Directory structure (3-5 lines)
   - Contact note: 'Generated by SaaS-Factory'
2. Append to CHANGELOG.md or create it with:
   ## YYYY-MM-DD
   - <feature 1 in one sentence>
   - <feature 2 in one sentence>
   ...

IMPORTANT: Keep it brief. At most 60 lines of README, 20 lines per CHANGELOG entry.
